ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 15:85 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white patch concentrated at the median notch vertex. Significant high-intensity mottling and contiguous patches located on the distal posterior region of the right lobe. Sparse, multi-directional high-intensity linear streaks distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (1-3 pixel peaks) along the majority of the trailing edge, transitioning to irregular macro-peaks at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curve fitted from the median notch to the distal apex of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, circular pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, indicating localized surface encrustation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) primarily concentrated on the medial and lateral regions of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the fluke surface and apical scarring at the lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Irregular jagged indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe, proximal to the median notch.
